name: Knox Wire Harnesses
old_description: Knox Wire Harnesses has served both the marine industry and our local community. Our central presence allows us to forge strong connections with local businesses and residents, reflecting our commitment to supporting the area that supports us. By delivering high-quality wiring harnesses and fostering community engagement, we strive to contribute positively to Knoxville's growth and success.
about:
Knox Wire Harnesses was founded in 2019 by Rob Brown in Knoxville, Tennessee. The company began as a local manufacturer focused on delivering high-quality wiring harnesses while building strong community ties.

The shop specializes in custom wire harness assemblies, offering rapid prototyping services and 100% electrical testing on every unit. Its end-to-end quality management system uses revision-controlled quotes, travelers, print-to-manufacture drawings, first articles, PPAPs, board layouts, and QA fixtures to ensure consistency from prototype through production runs.

The company primarily serves the marine industry, leveraging its ABYC Marine Electrical Certification to meet stringent safety and performance standards. It also works with local businesses and residents in the Knoxville area.

Brown's operating philosophy centers on "repaying the trust shown to us tenfold," emphasizing timely vendor payments, employee well-being, and on-time delivery to customers as the foundation for sustainable quality.
